evidence.section: Establishing gene-expression signature predictive of HBV vaccine response
evidence.quote: Three-hundred and thirty-five samples passing quality control were then amplified using the NuGEN amplification protocol and hybridized to Affymetrix HuRSTA-2a520709 chips (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, CA).

evidence.quote: Three FCM panels ( Supplementary Table 5 ) were respectively used to determine frequencies of T cells, B cells and innate immune cells obtained from the 174 pre-vaccination (Visit 2) samples of the study cohort.

hematology assay.readouts: 3 standard haematologic markers, including red blood cell counts

evidence.quote: A panel of 3 standard haematologic markers (complete blood count) was measured on the 174 pre-vaccination samples taken 28 days prior to vaccination (V1) of the EM131 cohort.
